notes: Security hardening for guest accounts, after a full review. (1) Guests can now only edit, delete or re-photo recipes they added themselves - everyone else's recipes are read-only to them (enforced on the server, and the Edit buttons only show on their own). (2) The recipe-URL importer is now SSRF-safe: it only fetches public internet addresses, pins the connection to the address it checked so a malicious site can't swap in an internal one, and re-checks every redirect - so it can't be used to reach your Home Assistant, cameras, network gear or the server itself. (3) Closed a cross-site gap where a guest's login could have carried over to the EVE and Ammo apps on the other subdomains; those now correctly refuse guest accounts. No changes for family accounts.
